name: SDWPF causal exception wiki for trend-residual prompting
description: Semantic residual prompts for observable exceptions. Ordinary stable/up/down dynamics remain owned by the original train-calibrated trend prompt branch.

scenes.title: No observable exception
scenes.prompt: No exceptional turbine state is observable in the historical SCADA window. Do not override the ordinary stable, upward-ramp, or downward-ramp trend prompt.

scenes.title: Gusty or turbulent exception
scenes.prompt: Recent wind speed contains unusually large variability or an abrupt jump. Correct the ordinary trend continuation conservatively because a smooth trend prompt may lag this transition.
observable_evidence: large recent wind-speed standard deviation or step

scenes.title: High wind with unexpectedly low power
scenes.prompt: Wind is sufficient for generation but observed power remains unexpectedly low. Treat this only as an observable exception, not a diagnosed cause; suppress aggressive recovery until historical evidence supports it.

scenes.title: Rated-power saturation exception
scenes.prompt: Observed power is close to rated capacity. Correct an unconstrained rising trend so the forecast respects saturation while still permitting a decline already visible in history.

scenes.title: Low-wind idle exception
scenes.prompt: Recent wind is below or near cut-in and observed power is low. Correct ordinary continuation toward a near-zero state unless recovery is already visible in the historical window.
